items.title: From Penny Stock to Takeover Target: Who Will Snap Up QuantumScape?
items.summary: QuantumScape holds solid-state battery IP that every major automaker quietly covets, yet its stock has lost more than half its value in a year. Five potential acquirers have the cash, the motive, and a reason to move before someone else does.

items.title: General Motors (GM) Is Up 14.8% After Q2 Results and Aggressive Capital Reshaping - What's Changed
items.summary: In July 2026, General Motors reported second-quarter results showing slightly higher revenue of US$48.03 billion but lower net income of US$1.31 billion year over year, while also declaring a US$0.18 quarterly dividend and completing a large share repurchase under its 2024 buyback program. At the same time, GM both retired roughly a quarter of its shares through buybacks and filed a US$2.05 billion shelf registration to issue common stock for its employee stock ownership plan, underscoring...
